glosses: A (usually) rectangular section of a surface, or of a covering or of a wall, fence etc.
A sunken compartment with raised margins, moulded or otherwise, as in ceilings, wainscotings, etc.
A group of people gathered to judge, interview, discuss etc. as on a television or radio broadcast for example.

examples.text: Today’s panel includes John Smith.

glosses: To enter (jury members) on an official list of jurors; to empanel.
